verdict.rationale: Probes show jo publicly serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec of its backend (about 405 paths, including /v1/auth and /v1/users) with Swagger UI at /docs. So an API surface exists and is self-documented. However, it is the app's backend and bridge API rather than a documented public developer API: no developer program, public API keys, or usage docs are described around it. missing for 10: a documented public developer API program, an API key/auth flow for third-party use, prose docs or guides for driving jo programmatically, and hands-on confirmation that users can actually call it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: with the Swagger UI served at /docs
